author: ericjwolverton
text:
Thinking with computers ~ The Maxims of Thinking With Computers. Do not look at infinite thoughts ~ you are used to one two and three, not hundreds. Do not think too big ~ your little brain may want to look through the endless computational simulations full of intelligent digital life, but those little eyeball muscles that drive your brain around really can’t handle driving that.

Anyways, AI Safety? Do not make a superintended that can find the key to our doom. Imagine quantum computation and molecular modeling ramp up, and the computer hands over a molecular key: “Makes water effortlessly and massively multiply in absolutely terrifying ways ~ breaks security protocol V~ Alpha.”
